reason: D-0061: when a channel sink refuses a run's start progress card, no card identity is stored and the terminal notification returns 'unsupported' for that route, so the run's completion never reaches the chat (run 224d1141). Send the terminal summary as a fresh done message when no identity exists. Scope: scheduler-lifecycle-notification.ts + lifecycle-retirement.test.ts.

quality.summary: Terminal notice is now delivered when the start card is refused, without duplicates in the reviewed races. Lite window Q-0080 (base 0978e25fd -> HEAD), D-0061: a refused start card left the run with no terminal notice. Fix: fresh done message for routes without an identity; per-route outcome memo (promise, set before await) shared by overlapping updates, repeated retirements and a late-landing start card; identity path seeds the memo; late-card clear uses a newer generation; unsupported retained, failed retryable; late summary edit registered; landed identity kept after a failed late edit; captures live until explicit discard. Proof: lifecycle-retirement + execution-notifications 58/58, tsc, architecture, verify.py passed each cycle. Autoreview: 9 cycles, 8 findings accepted+fixed, 1 pre-existing concurrency point deferred (D-0062), 1 triple-failure cosmetic residual deferred (D-0063) per the scope governor.
